name: Asia-Pacific

labor_laws: China: Labor Contract Law, Social Insurance Law
Japan: Labor Standards Act, Part-Time Work Act
India: Industrial Disputes Act, Shops & Establishments

work_culture.communication: Hierarchical. Indirect in Japan/Korea. Direct in Australia/India. 'Reading the air' (Japan).
work_culture.hierarchy: Strong hierarchy in Japan/Korea/China. Age and tenure respected. Formal titles always used.
work_culture.hours: Long hours in Japan/China/Korea (改善/加班). Australia: 38-hour norm. India: 9-hour+ in tech.
work_culture.remote: Varied. Japan reluctant. India/China hybrid. Australia flexible. Singapore open.
work_culture.diversity_focus: Gender diversity growing. Age hierarchy accepted. Less ethnic diversity focus than NA/Europe.

industry_context.saas: India massive IT/services. China domestic giants (Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu). Japan slower SaaS adoption.
industry_context.fintech: China/Alipay+WeChat dominance. India UPI revolution. Singapore financial hub. Japan slower.
industry_context.healthcare: Japan aging population focus. India medical tourism. China digital health growing.
industry_context.manufacturing: China: world's factory. Japan/Korea: advanced manufacturing. Vietnam: growing manufacturing hub.
industry_context.ecommerce: Alibaba, JD (China). Flipkart, Meesho (India). Shopee (SEA). Rakuten (Japan). Coupang (Korea).

currency: CNY / JPY / INR / KRW / SGD / AUD / IDR
reporting_standards: IFRS-adopted (most) / Japan: JGAAP / China: CAS / India: Ind AS
